body:
[Written by Claude]

**UniProt UniRule (ID and label):**
UR000079182 (from HAMAP MF_00168), tRNA-guanine transglycosylase, Bacteria; catalytic activity RHEA:24104 / EC 2.4.2.29

**Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
- P0A847 tgt, Queuine tRNA-ribosyltransferase (*Escherichia coli* K-12)
- P28720 tgt, Queuine tRNA-ribosyltransferase (*Zymomonas mobilis*)
- All proteins matched by the rule: 461 reviewed + 14,388 unreviewed

**Description of issue**
UR000079182 assigns GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity) to bacterial Tgt. That term now maps to EC 2.4.2.64 and RHEA:16633, the eukaryotic QTRT1 reaction that inserts queuine. Bacteria insert preQ1 instead, and the rule's own catalytic activity is that reaction (RHEA:24104, EC 2.4.2.29).

A new term for the preQ1 reaction was created in geneontology/go-ontology#32883 (PR geneontology/go-ontology#32911):

- GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity), mapped to EC:2.4.2.29 and RHEA:24104 (skos:exactMatch)

Requested change: in UR000079182, replace GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity) with GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity). GO:0006400 (tRNA modification) is unaffected. The eukaryotic QTRT1 rule UR000370983 (MF_03218) is correct as it stands.

GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity) was merged on 2026-11-10 and will be available from the next GO release.
title: UniRule2GO issue: UR000079182 (bacterial Tgt) should map to GO:7770158

author: raymond91125
source_title: EcoCyc annotation review: E. coli tgt (P0A847) GO:0008479 to GO:7770158 (preQ1 transglycosylase)
